sections.text_helper: Section 35.8.20 "TIM alternate function register 2 (TIM_AF2)" in chapter 35 (General purpose timers (TIM15/TIM16/TIM17)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1444.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x064
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:20 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 19:16 OCRSEL[3:0]: ocref_clr source selection
These bits select the ocref_clr input source.
0000: tim_ocref_clr0
0001: tim_ocref_clr1
...
1111: tim_ocref_clr15
Refer to Section35.5.2: TIM15/TIM16/TIM17 pins and internalsignals for product specific
implementation.
Note: These bits can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK
bits in TIM_BDTR register).
Bits 15:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
